faq.q: How much does Sotelo Law Group charge?
faq.a: Sotelo Law Group publishes a contingency fee, which means the fee is a share of what the case recovers and there is nothing to pay if it recovers nothing. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Sotelo Law Group offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Sotelo Law Group publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Sotelo Law Group have offices?
faq.a: Sotelo Law Group publishes one office, in Phoenix. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Sotelo Law Group?
faq.a: Sotelo Law Group names one attorney on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Arizona does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.
